items.action: run or download scraper execution output

database.reason: No product data schema changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Core already migrated these legacy action codes to canonical execute/read permissions.

notes: Core migrations 0049/0050 and current Fair CRM authorization use canonical read/execute permissions. Frontend permission helpers must not request retired run/download/render/test_send/preview/send/apply codes. Fair-scoped scraper and enrichment endpoints likewise name their backend authorization constant and dependency after the canonical fair_crm.scraper.execute capability while preserving the same runtime permission value and behavior.
